- 1936 – 1957: K. Terzaghi (USA) - First President

The second president of the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering was **A. W. Skempton** (Sir Alec Westley Skempton).

The second president of the International Society for Soil Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering (ISSMGE) was **A. W. Skempton** (Sir Alec Westley Skempton), who served from 1957 to 1961. He succeeded Karl Terzaghi, the first president and founder of the society.
